answer: Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the sonnet log reveals the live set and the echo audit records each lapse. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 173 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Keeping 66 aliases alive therefore means 66 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the basalt quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
